# v1.9.3 — Search includes Nabava entries

- Extended global search to match board To-Do and manually added Nabava items (case-insensitive title search, capped at 50 results).
- Search results identify Nabava entries and show their project/board origin or manual-entry status, including a purchased marker when checked.
- Selecting a board item opens its board; selecting a manual item opens the global Nabava view (and switches to that tab on mobile).
- Fixed search results remaining onscreen after selecting any result; navigation now clears the search view and displays the destination.
- Updated search placeholder text to include Nabava.

## Verification

- Verified API and browser results for both item types; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis passed and all 7 Flutter tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.9.3+9**.
